BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to service animals in training; and amending RCW70.84.020 and 70.84.021.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.84.020 and 1997 c 271 s 18 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purpose of this chapter, the term "dog guide" means a dogthat is trained, or in training, for the purpose of guiding blindpersons or ((a dog trained for the purpose of)) assisting hearingimpaired persons.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.84.021 and 1997 c 271 s 19 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purpose of this chapter, "service animal" means an animalthat is trained, or in training, for the purposes of assisting oraccommodating a ((disabled)) person's sensory, mental, or physicaldisability.
